title: Multiscale Methods
subtitle: The scales of a system’s behavior determine what it can do. By comparing these scales to the tasks for which the system is designed, we can see whether or not it can achieve its goals and why. Multiscale Analysis proves useful in the study of large organizations, such as healthcare, the military, and corporations.
